name: Relay Recovery
description: Investigate the collapsed relay station on the outer ring and recover what you can.

find_relay.label: Find the Collapsed Relay Station
find_relay.description: Follow Kade's map data to find the side path in the outer ring leading to the old relay station.

solve_puzzle.label: Restore Power to the Relay
solve_puzzle.description: Reroute power through both junction boxes to open the sealed maintenance hatch.

defeat_nest_mother.label: Defeat the Nest Mother
defeat_nest_mother.description: Clear the creature that has nested in the relay station's maintenance area.

recover_relay_log.label: Recover the Relay Log
recover_relay_log.description: Search the relay station for the operations log.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: Relay Recovery. The relay log may interest Comms Officer Daley back at Outpost Balor.
